title: Boundary-supported maps to and from the shifted middle extension vanish
statement:
Fix $k_0=\mathbf F_q$, its algebraic closure $k$, and a prime $\ell\ne\operatorname{char}(k_0)$ [def-weil-finite-field-fiber]. Let $C_0$ be a smooth geometrically connected separated curve of finite type over $k_0$, where smooth means [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms] and curve means pure dimension one [def-weil-pure-dimension]. Let $j_0:U_0\hookrightarrow C_0$ be a dense open immersion [def-weil-open-immersion], and let $i_0:Z_0\hookrightarrow C_0$ be its reduced closed complement [def-weil-closed-immersion]. Write $C,U,Z,j,i$ for their base changes to $k$.

Let $F_0$ be a lisse $\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$-Weil sheaf on $U_0$ [def-pod-lisse-l-adic-sheaves, def-weil-weil-sheaf-complex], with underlying geometric sheaf $F$. Put $A=j_*F$, using the ordinary sheaf direct image [def-wf-middle-extension]. A constructible sheaf on $T=C$ or $Z$ means an object of the standard constructible heart $\mathrm{Sh}_c(T,\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell)$ [def-weil-constructible-heart], interpreted in the finite-coefficient-field category $D^b_c(T,\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell)$ [def-weil-pbc-qbar-category]. Regard sheaves as complexes in degree zero and use cohomological shift [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. For every constructible sheaf $E$ on $Z$,
$$\operatorname{Hom}_{D^b_c(C,\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell)}(i_*E,A[1])=0,\qquad
\operatorname{Hom}_{D^b_c(C,\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell)}(A[1],i_*E)=0.$$
Here $i_*$ is ordinary closed direct image.

If $E_0$ is a constructible $\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$-Weil sheaf on $Z_0$ with underlying geometric sheaf $E$, give $A$ and $i_*E$ the induced Frobenius structures. Both Hom groups also vanish in the category of Frobenius pairs of [def-weil-weil-sheaf-complex]. No Frobenius structure on an arbitrary geometric sheaf $E$ is assumed.

source.place: Second paragraph, the assertion that the curve intermediate extension has no boundary perverse subobjects or quotients; this node isolates the derived Hom vanishing used to prove that assertion

proof.text: Work in $\mathcal T=D^b_c(C,\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell)$ with its ordinary t-structure. Put $B=i_*E$. By [lem-a1-qbar-open-closed-cohomology], $A=j_*F$ is constructible since $F$ is lisse, $B$ is a constructible sheaf since closed direct image is exact on sheaves, and $j^*B=0$ by the stated essential-image characterization of $i_*$. Thus $A,B$ belong to the standard heart. The same node supplies the exact restriction $j^*$ on hearts and the ordinary sheaf adjunction $j^*\dashv j_*$ with counit $\epsilon_F:j^*j_*F\xrightarrow{\sim}F$.

source.place: Ordinary j_* convention, supplemented by the cited open-closed cohomology statement

proof.text: Let $\delta:B\to A[1]$ be arbitrary. The completion and rotation axioms of [def-weil-triangulated-category] give a distinguished triangle $A\xrightarrow{a}M\xrightarrow{b}B\xrightarrow{\delta}A[1]$. Since its outer objects $A,B$ lie in the heart, extension-closure in clause (2) of [lem-weil-heart-short-exact-triangles] puts $M$ in the heart. Clause (4) then makes its first three arrows the short exact sequence $0\to A\xrightarrow{a}M\xrightarrow{b}B\to0$ in constructible sheaves. All these constructions take place in the geometric triangulated category.

source.place: 1.2.3–1.2.6 and 1.3.4–1.3.6, printed pp. 27–31: extension-closed heart and admissible short exact sequences

proof.text: Apply the exact restriction of [lem-a1-qbar-open-closed-cohomology] to this short exact sequence. Because $j^*B=0$, $j^*a:j^*A\to j^*M$ is an isomorphism. Set $t=\epsilon_F\circ(j^*a)^{-1}:j^*M\to F$ and let $r:M\to j_*F=A$ be its adjoint under the same node's ordinary sheaf adjunction. Naturality of the Hom bijection sends $r\circ a$ to $t\circ j^*a=\epsilon_F$. The identity of $j_*F$ also corresponds to $\epsilon_F$, by the defining counit formula for adjunction. Injectivity of that bijection therefore gives $r\circ a=\operatorname{id}_A$. This writes the retraction explicitly; it uses neither exactness of $j_*$ nor injectivity of $F$.

source.place: Ordinary direct-image convention; explicit adjunction retraction argument supplied here

proof.text: Apply clause (i) of [lem-weil-pbc-hom-into-triangle-exact] to the twice-rotated distinguished triangle, whose first arrows are $B\xrightarrow{\delta}A[1]\xrightarrow{-a[1]}M[1]$. Consecutive arrows compose to zero, hence $a[1]\circ\delta=0$. Since shifts are functors [def-weil-triangulated-category], the retraction identity gives $r[1]\circ a[1]=\operatorname{id}_{A[1]}$, so $\delta=r[1]\circ a[1]\circ\delta=0$. As $\delta$ was arbitrary, $\operatorname{Hom}(i_*E,A[1])=0$.

Because shift is an automorphism [def-weil-triangulated-category], $\operatorname{Hom}(A[1],B)\cong\operatorname{Hom}(A,B[-1])$. Both $A,B$ lie in the ordinary heart from Step 1. In particular $A\in\mathcal T^{\le0}$ and $B\in\mathcal T^{\ge0}$, so axiom (2) of [def-weil-t-structure] says that the latter group is zero. This proves the reverse Hom vanishing.

Finally suppose $E$ underlies the specified Weil sheaf $E_0$. The Frobenius compatibility in [lem-a1-qbar-open-closed-cohomology] gives the induced Frobenius structures on the ordinary direct images, and the shifted structure is understood as in [def-weil-weil-sheaf-complex]. By clause (2) of that definition, forgetting a morphism of Frobenius pairs is faithful and keeps its underlying geometric morphism. Each of the two Hom sets of pairs therefore injects into the corresponding zero geometric Hom group proved above. The zero geometric map satisfies the Frobenius commutation equation, so each Hom set consists exactly of zero. No triangle or short exact sequence in a category of Weil pairs is used, and this argument imposes no Frobenius structure on an arbitrary geometric $E$.

source.place: Weil sheaf convention; forgetting Frobenius pairs after geometric vanishing

proof_origin.place: Ordinary j_* convention and intermediate-extension assertion; explicit heart-extension and adjunction proof, using BBD 1.2.3–1.3.6 and Stacks Tags 0145 and 0146

split_report.summary: Proved both geometric Hom vanishings without adding nodes: an arbitrary degree-one map yields an extension in the ordinary heart, and restriction followed by ordinary j^*–j_* adjunction constructs a retraction. A consecutive-arrow identity kills the connecting map. The reverse direction is negative-degree orthogonality; faithfulness gives the Frobenius-pair claims. Statement and existing ancestry retained.
split_report.blueprint: Realizes the derived boundary-map input to the ordinary shifted middle-extension assertion in rem-dl-a1-conventions, via the boundary-subobject/quotient argument of lem-dl-a1-curve-intermediate-extension; the setup unit has no proof steps to replace.

tool_uses.why: Uses its standard heart, exact open restriction, closed supported sheaves, ordinary open adjunction, and Frobenius compatibility as geometric tools. The setup unit has no proof steps or cited units providing these interfaces.
Uses clauses (2) and (4) for an arbitrary t-structure to realize a degree-one map as a short exact sequence in the standard heart. The setup unit supplies no generic heart theorem.

reviewed.note: mechanical checks by tools/merge_delivery.py; mathematics reviewed in full by NT-cc-Q03-e5d4dcc22 (reviewer sub-agent of L); spot-checked: I read the whole item: the statement and all six steps, every cited node's statement, the parent's Step 2, the rem-dl-a1-conventions blueprint source, BBD 1.2.4–1.2.6, 1.3.1 and 1.3.6, and Stacks Tags 0145 and 0146. The statement is unchanged and true; I checked it independently: i^!(j_*F)[1] lies in D^{>=1}, and the second Hom vanishes by negative-degree orthogonality. Edge cases checked: Z empty, E=0, F=0, j=id, the constant sheaf on G_m in A^1, and nontrivial inertia. Each step uses only what its cited statement says. Step 1: lem-a1-qbar-open-closed-cohomology gives the heart, t-exactness of j^*, the essential image of i_* and the sheaf adjunction j^* -| j_*. Step 2: clauses (2) and (4) of the heart lemma. Step 3: I checked the adjunction retraction r∘a=id. Step 4: clause (i) of the composition-zero leaf on the rotated triangle. Steps 5 and 6: axiom (2) of the t-structure and faithfulness of the forgetful functor on Frobenius pairs, both correctly marked elementary. There are no new nodes, no cycle, no duplicate in the DAG and no SGA citation. I accept both tool_uses (the open/closed node and the heart short-exact-triangles lemma), since the setup unit has no steps. Batch 5: the closure of lem-a1-qbar-open-closed-cohomology reaches sec-poincare-duality only through the general definition def-pod-lisse-l-adic-sheaves (already a statement dependency of the item), lisse-sheaf foundations and generic homological algebra. None of these is the trace formula, Poincaré duality or a step of their proofs, so the citation is allowed.
